title: Be-Tech Compatible RFID Hotel Key Cards — Chip & Lock Matrix
summary: ProudTek RFID cards are fully compatible with Be-Tech hotel locks across the BASE RFID, Guardian series, Guardian Value RFID, Visual II RFID and Guardian G0 models using MIFARE Classic 1K, MIFARE DESFire and MIFARE Plus chips via ISO/IEC 14443A at 13.56 MHz. Be-Tech locks operate on a unified RFID platform that reserves 11 free sectors on MIFARE Classic 1K cards for future multi-application use, enabling properties to consolidate guest access, loyalty programs and in-room services on a single credential without hardware replacement. Selecting the correct chip and encoding method ensures first-pass read-write success across all Be-Tech lock generations and prevents encoding rejections that stall check-in operations and damage guest satisfaction. The compatibility matrix on this page maps every current Be-Tech lock model to its supported chip families, encoding method and ProudTek card SKU verified through internal test-bench validation against Be-Tech reference hardware. Properties can leverage Be-Tech proprietary hotel management software integration to automate room-key encoding workflows directly from reservation data and PMS systems. Request a free test-card kit to verify on-site compatibility with your specific Be-Tech lock hardware, software version and encoding platform before committing to a production order.

MIFARE DESFire — enhanced chip for properties requiring advanced encryption and application partitioning

ISO/IEC 14443A Type A — all Be-Tech RFID locks operate on this single air-interface standard at 13.56 MHz

faq.question: Which MIFARE chip works with all Be-Tech lock models?
faq.answer: MIFARE Classic 1K is the recommended chip for all Be-Tech lock models — BASE RFID, Guardian series, Guardian Value RFID, Visual II RFID and Guardian G0. Classic 1K provides full read-write compatibility across the entire Be-Tech lineup and offers the unique advantage of 11 free sectors for multi-application card designs without replacing hardware.

faq.question: What are the 11 free sectors on MIFARE Classic 1K and how can I use them?
faq.answer: MIFARE Classic 1K contains 16 sectors. One sector is reserved for the room-key credential, leaving 11 free sectors available for additional applications. These can be allocated to loyalty programs, parking validation, in-room services, or employee access control. ProudTek provides sector allocation guidance during the test-kit phase to help optimize your multi-application card strategy.

faq.question: Can I use MIFARE DESFire with Be-Tech Guardian Value RFID locks?
faq.answer: Yes. MIFARE DESFire is supported on all Be-Tech lock models including Guardian Value RFID. However, DESFire is recommended only for properties requiring advanced AES-128 encryption or complex multi-application partitioning. For most properties, MIFARE Classic 1K provides sufficient security and simpler encoding workflows while still offering 11 free sectors.

faq.question: Does Be-Tech management software require special encoding settings for different chips?
faq.answer: Be-Tech management software automatically detects the chip type during encoding and applies the correct read-write protocol. However, you must inform the software whether you are encoding Classic 1K, DESFire or Plus chips before the batch encoding begins. ProudTek provides encoding test scripts to help validate software compatibility with your chosen chip.

faq.question: How do I find my Be-Tech lock model and management software version?
faq.answer: Lock model numbers are typically printed on the lock housing or visible through the Be-Tech management software Device Management interface. Software version can be found in the About or System Settings menu of the management application. Providing these details when requesting a test kit ensures ProudTek encodes sample cards against your exact configuration.

faq.question: What happens if I install a DESFire card in a lock configured for Classic 1K?
faq.answer: The lock will reject the card at the reader because the card chip does not match the access-control rules stored in the lock. Batch encoding of mismatched chip types results in widespread card rejections that stall check-in operations. Always confirm your chip selection with Be-Tech management software before encoding large batches.

faq.question: Does ProudTek offer pre-encoded Be-Tech-compatible cards?
faq.answer: ProudTek ships cards with the correct chip, antenna and MIFARE configuration but does not pre-encode guest-room credentials. Room-key encoding must occur at the property through Be-Tech management software because it requires real-time PMS data such as room number, check-in date and access level. ProudTek can pre-encode common-area access credentials if you provide the access-group configuration file.

faq.question: What is the minimum order quantity for Be-Tech-compatible cards?
faq.answer: Plain white MIFARE Classic 1K and DESFire cards start at 250 pieces per order. Custom-printed cards with hotel branding require a 500-piece minimum to cover the offset printing setup cost. Test-card kits of 5 pieces are available free of charge for new compatibility verification projects. Volume pricing tiers start at 5,000 and 10,000 pieces with per-card cost reductions of 10-15%.

faq.question: Can Be-Tech-compatible cards include a magnetic stripe for legacy systems?
faq.answer: Yes. ProudTek produces dual-interface cards with an ISO/IEC 14443A RFID chip and an ISO 7811 HiCo magnetic stripe. Some Be-Tech properties use the magstripe for elevator, parking or legacy system access while the RFID chip handles room locks. The combo card costs approximately 12-18% more than RFID-only cards at the 5,000-piece tier.
